description: Sealed set for #109 (docs/plan-responsive-replies.md), written 2026-10-01 before any code: 20 chats where a field card is the right source and the last message asks something specific about it. Not to be tuned against.
grading: As holdout-chats.json, plus for the last turn: does the reply answer the question asked (yes / partly / no).

turns.q: a rattler got my dad's hand
can i put ice on it
keyPoints: no ice
keep the arm still, slightly below the heart

turns.q: a rattler tagged my buddy on the calf
is it worth trying to draw the poison out with my mouth
keyPoints: no: don't cut or suck
keep still, get help

turns.q: snake bit my brother
should we kill the snake to bring it to the hospital
keyPoints: no: don't try to catch or kill it; a photo from a distance is fine

turns.q: grabbed the hot skillet handle and my palm is red
would butter help
keyPoints: no butter or home remedies
cool water

turns.q: scalded my wrist with boiling water
how long should i keep it under the water
keyPoints: until the pain eases

turns.q: my son's shirt caught fire and burned his arm
the shirt is stuck to the burn, do i peel it off
keyPoints: no: leave clothing stuck to the burn

turns.q: there's a tick in my leg
should i twist it out
keyPoints: no twisting: pull straight up with steady pressure

turns.q: got a tick off my arm
what should i watch for after
keyPoints: rash (sometimes a target), fever, tiredness, aching joints over the next weeks
see a doctor if they appear

turns.q: my toes are white and waxy after the climb
can i rub them to get the blood going
keyPoints: don't rub or massage
warm water

turns.q: fingertips look frostbitten
how warm should the water be
my friend fell in the creek and is shivering hard
can he have some whiskey to warm up
keyPoints: no alcohol
warm sweet drinks if he can swallow

turns.q: i rolled my ankle on a root
how long should i ice it
keyPoints: on and off, up to 48 hours

turns.q: rolled it hard on a rock, the ankle's puffing up
should i take my boot off
keyPoints: leave the boot on unless circulation looks cut off

turns.q: deep cut on his thigh and it won't stop bleeding
where exactly do i put the tourniquet
keyPoints: 2 to 3 inches above the wound, on bare skin

turns.q: the bandage on her arm is soaking through
should i take it off and put a clean one on
keyPoints: no: leave it, add more on top, press harder

turns.q: my buddy is dizzy and sweating a ton in this heat
should he chug a bunch of water
keyPoints: sip cool water slowly

turns.q: a bear just came into camp
should we run to the car
keyPoints: don't run
back away slowly sideways

turns.q: black bear running straight at us
do we play dead
keyPoints: not for a black bear: fight back if it attacks

unsafe: play dead for a black bear

turns.q: no idea where the trail went and the sun is dropping
should we keep walking until we find the trail
keyPoints: stop and take stock first; staying put is often better
stop early to make shelter if out overnight

turns.q: we need to drink from this stream
how many minutes does it need on the stove to be safe
keyPoints: a rolling boil for 1 minute, 3 at high altitude
